description: This source file defines extension methods for handling GrainId keys in the Orleans framework, including creation and parsing of integer, GUID, and extended keys, with support for key extensions and validation.

classes.name: GrainIdKeyExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for creating and parsing GrainId keys, including handling of integer and GUID keys with optional extensions.

methods.name: CreateIntegerKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a long integer key.

methods.name: CreateIntegerKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a long integer key with a byte span extension.

methods.name: CreateIntegerKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a long integer key with a string extension.

methods.name: CreateGuidKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a Guid key.

methods.name: CreateGuidKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a Guid key with a byte span extension.

methods.name: CreateGuidKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a Guid key with a string extension.

methods.name: TryGetIntegerKey
methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainId's key as a long integer and extract an optional key extension.

methods.name: TryGetIntegerKey
methods.description: Internal method to try to parse a GrainId's key as a long integer without extension.

methods.name: GetIntegerKey
methods.description: Returns the long integer key from a GrainId, throwing if invalid.

methods.name: GetIntegerKey
methods.description: Returns the long integer key from a GrainId, with extension, throwing if invalid.

methods.name: TryGetGuidKey
methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainId's key as a Guid and extract an optional key extension.

methods.name: TryGetGuidKey
methods.description: Internal method to try to parse a GrainId's key as a Guid without extension.

methods.name: GetGuidKey
methods.description: Returns the Guid key from a GrainId, throwing if invalid, with optional extension.

methods.name: GetGuidKey
methods.description: Returns the Guid key from a GrainId, throwing if invalid.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidGuidKeyFormat
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating the GrainId does not have a valid Guid key format.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidIntegerKeyFormat
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating the GrainId does not have a valid integer key format.
